claim: The Si/O atomic ratio and mass density of PECVD SiO2 films strongly depend on deposition conditions including precursor flow ratios, RF power, and deposition temperature.
falsifier: The association can be tested by systematically varying each deposition parameter and measuring the resulting film properties.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported dependencies in the literature; the specific functional relationships may depend on the reactor and precursor system.

title: Deposition conditions–Film properties: Si/O atomic principle
